extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and the popup heading.

extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser's extension list.

popupEnable.description: Label of the popup switch that shows or hides the toolbar.

btnVideo.description: Toolbar button name (tooltip and accessible label).

btnMp3.description: Toolbar button name (tooltip and accessible label).

btnThumbnail.description: Toolbar button name (tooltip and accessible label).

btnSubtitles.description: Toolbar button name (tooltip and accessible label).

btnScreenshot.description: Toolbar button name (tooltip and accessible label).

btnDarkMode.description: Toolbar button name (tooltip and accessible label).

btnCinema.description: Toolbar button name. Dims the page around the player; not YouTube's own theater mode.

btnPip.description: Toolbar button name (tooltip and accessible label).

btnFloating.description: Toolbar button name (tooltip and accessible label).

btnLoop.description: Toolbar button name (tooltip and accessible label).

btnMore.description: Toolbar button name (tooltip and accessible label).

btnHelp.description: Toolbar button name (tooltip and accessible label).

btnClose.description: Toolbar button name. Hides the toolbar.

panelTitleVideo.description: Title of the video download panel.

panelPin.description: Button that keeps the panel open.

panelUnpin.description: Button that releases a pinned panel and closes it.

comingSoon.description: Placeholder for features that are not implemented yet.

loading.description: Shown while panel content is loading.

retry.description: Button that retries loading panel content.

helpVideo.message: 選擇畫質下載這部影片。
helpVideo.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Video button.

helpMp3.message: 把聲音下載成 MP3，可以只下載其中一段。
helpMp3.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the MP3 button.

helpThumbnail.message: 下載不同尺寸的影片縮圖。
helpThumbnail.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Thumbnail button.

helpSubtitles.message: 下載字幕，格式可選 SRT、VTT 或純文字。
helpSubtitles.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Subtitles button.

helpScreenshot.message: 把目前的影片畫面存成 PNG 圖片。
helpScreenshot.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Screenshot button.

btnLink.description: Toolbar button name. Opens the copy link panel.

helpLink.message: 複製這部影片的短網址，可以從目前的時間開始。
helpLink.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Link button.

panelTitleLink.description: Title of the copy link panel.

linkAtTime.description: Link panel: option that copies a youtu.be link starting at the current time.

linkMarkdown.description: Link panel: option that copies a Markdown link with the title and time.

linkPlain.description: Link panel: option that copies a youtu.be link without a time.

linkCopied.description: Link panel: shown for about 2 seconds after copying.

linkCopyFailed.message: 無法複製到剪貼簿，請選取下方文字後自行複製。
linkCopyFailed.description: Link panel: error when the browser refuses clipboard access.

helpDarkMode.message: 切換 YouTube 的深色與淺色主題。
helpDarkMode.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Dark mode button.

helpCinema.message: 讓播放器以外的整個頁面變暗。
helpCinema.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Cinema mode button.

helpPip.message: 在獨立的小視窗中播放影片。
helpPip.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Picture-in-picture button.

helpFloating.message: 往下捲動時，讓播放器固定在畫面角落繼續播放。
helpFloating.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Floating player button.

helpLoop.message: 重複播放整部影片或其中一段。
helpLoop.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Loop button.

helpMore.message: 更多選項，例如切換分頁時自動暫停影片。
helpMore.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the More button.

helpHelp.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Help button.

helpClose.message: 隱藏工具列，可以從擴充功能的彈出視窗重新開啟。
helpClose.description: Help panel: one-sentence description of the Close button.

helpOpenSettings.description: Help panel: link that opens the extension's settings page.

optionsTitle.description: Title of the extension's settings page.

optionsTidyTitle.description: Settings page: heading of the page tidy section.

optionsTidyDesc.message: 設定一次就一直生效的 YouTube 頁面調整。開關後已開啟的 YouTube 分頁立即生效，工具列關閉時也照常作用。
optionsTidyDesc.description: Settings page: one-line explanation under the page tidy heading.

optionsDownloadsTitle.description: Settings page: heading of the downloads section.

tidyOriginalAudioDesc.message: YouTube 播放自動配音（AI 配音）時，自動切換到影片的原始語音。

tidyHideEndCards.message: 隱藏片尾推薦卡片與結尾畫面

tidyHideEndCardsDesc.message: 隱藏影片最後幾秒的推薦卡片，以及播完後的推薦影片格狀畫面；自動播放下一部照常運作。

tidyAutoContinue.message: 自動關閉「要繼續觀看嗎？」

tidyAutoContinueDesc.message: YouTube 暫停影片並詢問「影片已暫停，要繼續觀看嗎？」時，自動關閉對話框並繼續播放。

tidyNoThumbnailPreviewDesc.message: 滑鼠停在縮圖上時不播放預覽，縮圖維持靜態圖片。

tidyShortsToWatchDesc.message: 開啟 Shorts 連結時改以一般觀看頁播放，可以使用完整的播放器與工具列。

tidyHideShortsDesc.message: 隱藏首頁、訂閱、搜尋結果、推薦清單與左側選單中的 Shorts。

tidyFullTitlesDesc.message: 影片清單中的標題完整顯示，不截斷成「…」。

pipUnsupported.description: Tooltip reason when the browser has no native picture-in-picture.

floatingDrag.description: Tooltip of the drag handle on the floating player.

floatingClose.description: Close button on the floating player; the player returns to its place until the next scroll away.

loopModeLabel.description: Accessible label of the loop mode radio group.

loopModeRepeat.description: Loop panel: mode that repeats the whole video N times.

loopTimesLabel.description: Loop panel: accessible label of the number input.

loopTimesUnit.description: Loop panel: unit after the number input.

loopTimesError.description: Loop panel: error for an invalid number of times.

loopModeSegment.description: Loop panel: mode that loops between a start and an end time.

loopPlayedCount.description: Loop panel: how many times the video or segment has been played.

timeStart.description: Label of the start time input and slider handle.

timeEnd.description: Label of the end time input and slider handle.

timeErrorOutOfRange.description: Time input error: later than the end of the video.

timeErrorOrder.description: Time input error: start is not before end.

moreSmartPauseDesc.message: 切換到其他分頁或視窗最小化時暫停影片，回來時繼續播放。

moreAutoplayDesc.message: 與 YouTube 播放器上的自動播放開關同步。

moreAutoplayMissing.message: 這個頁面找不到 YouTube 的自動播放開關。
moreAutoplayMissing.description: More panel: shown when YouTube's autoplay switch cannot be found.

moreAudioOnlyDesc.message: 以縮圖取代影片畫面。只隱藏畫面，不保證節省頻寬。

moreWheelVolumeDesc.message: 游標在播放器上時用滾輪調整音量，每格 5%。

moreHideCommentsDesc.message: 隱藏影片下方的留言區。

moreQualityLockDesc.message: 每部影片都以這個畫質播放；影片沒有這個畫質時，使用低於它的最高畫質。

qualityOff.description: Quality lock option: let YouTube choose the quality.

qualityMax.description: Quality lock option: always use the highest quality of the video.

volumeHint.description: Accessible label of the volume indicator shown over the player.
